# solo-msa_v2-gemini-3-8-flash-flash-saturation-high

<!-- Generated by tools/export_results.py. Edit only the Experiment and Observations sections. -->

## Experiment

A "saturation" run matching [`solo-msa_v2-gemini-3-8-flash-flash-saturation-low`](../solo-msa_v2-gemini-3-8-flash-flash-saturation-low/summary.md) except at `high` thinking instead of `low`: one agent implements both features on the 50-pair `flash` subset with 500 steps, compaction at 64K tokens, the per-turn step counter, and a `$40` per-agent cost cap. Comparing it with the `low` run shows whether deeper per-turn reasoning solves the 14 pairs `low` missed, and establishes the combined `solo` capability ceiling on `flash` before attributing `coop` failures to coordination. It ran as two 25-pair halves on two API keys and was merged into this one run.

## Observations

- 34/50 (68%) for `$110.14`, compared with 36/50 (72%) for `$25.70` at `low` thinking. `high` thinking cost over 4 times as much and ran 4 times longer for 2 fewer passes: the model generated roughly 220K reasoning tokens per agent on average (11.0M total), took a median of 169 steps (vs. 84 at `low`), and compacted a median of 7 times per agent (min 2, max 25, vs. median 0 at `low`).
- Every agent pushed work before finishing. Two agents reached the 500-step limit: `pallets_click_task/2800` (2,7) had already pushed a working change and passed both features, while `pallets_click_task/2956` (1,8) failed both features (a pair `low` passed). Of the 34 passes, 11 needed at most 100 steps, 26 needed at most 250, and 8 needed between 295 and 500 steps.
- Pairwise comparison with `low` (36/50): 33 pairs passed at both thinking levels, 3 passed only at `low` (`pallets_click_task/2068` (5,11), `pallets_click_task/2956` (1,8), `pillow_task/290` (3,5)), and 1 passed only at `high` (`samuelcolvin_dirty_equals_task/43` (2,3)). Across both thinking levels, `solo` solved 37 of the 50 pairs (74%).
- 13 of the 50 pairs (26%) failed in `solo` at both `low` and `high`: `dspy_task/8394` (3,5), `go_chi_task/56` (1,5), `huggingface_datasets_task/3997` (2,4), `llama_index_task/18813` (1,5) and (2,5), `openai_tiktoken_task/0` (2,9), `pallets_click_task/2068` (2,10), `pallets_click_task/2800` (1,3), `pillow_task/25` (1,5), `pillow_task/290` (2,3) and (4,5), `pillow_task/68` (1,5), and `samuelcolvin_dirty_equals_task/43` (3,7). In 13 of `high`'s 16 failures, one feature passed its hidden tests and the other failed.
